source: S5/README.md and S5/CURRICULUM.md (this repository, branch hola)
note: Production numbers from the S5 submission. The demo executes the same object with scale_divisor applied. Shares are stated exactly as S5 decided them; supply figures are S5's audited values, not the course inventory's.
epoch_ceiling_source: arXiv:2305.16264 - up to 4 epochs of repeated data costs negligible loss
supply_note: S5 SUPPLY-AUDIT.md. Indic corrected 275.9B -> 157.2B (English split inside Sangraha verified tier; synthetic tier double-counted via transliteration). Reasoning: 78B of 85.1B is V4 AON lineage.
protected_floors_source: S5 README section 1. OPUS measured to drive unprotected lanes to zero: Indic 0 tokens in 60/60 iterations, agentic 0 in 59/60. Floors are mechanism, not policy.
anneal_reserve_note: Held back from the main run; spendable only in the anneal stage. S5 decision 2/3, tested by T3.
seam_rules: Embeddings remain trainable across every seam (measured: 151x gradient spike frozen vs 8.0x unfrozen).
Blend every seam over at least 2B tokens (measured peak 2.8x, under the 3x stability threshold).
Final seam gets 4B: largest shift, and where a diverged run is most expensive to lose.
packing_policy_note: Agentic is structure-preserving because S5 requires tool-call ordering to survive; the cost is measured window utilization, reported in performance.json.

opus.note: Threshold is on cosine alignment between candidate batch gradient and the golden proxy direction. Demand inflation is need = budget * share / (1 - rejection_rate).

agentic_loss_mask.source: S5 BENCHMARK-MAP.md. Measured supervision yield on the reference trajectory: 356 supervised / 668 seen = 53%. A failed tool call IS supervised: recovery is the taught behaviour.
